name: mode
label: Opened
description: What context the alert item is in, either 'toast' or 'tray'.

name: sysId
label: SysId
description: SysId of the record that triggered the alert.

name: table
label: Table
description: Table the notification was triggered for.

name: hideTray
label: Hide Tray
description: Determines whether to hide the tray on notification item clicked.
